verdicts.reason: A drops the cream card, so the headline, body copy, logo and legal line all sit directly on the busy confetti. A leftover card fragment floats behind the body copy, and confetti pieces cut through the 'Inkwell & Lantern' logo and the fine print, making both hard to read. B keeps the card, so all text sits on a clean panel and the headline is clearly the main element. But B's logo is shrunk to an illegible speck, the CTA button is tiny and much weaker than the large body copy, and the legal text is too small to read at this size.
